_comment: Illustration grouping. Each group lists CHARACTER BASE NAMES; the server expands them to every existing file (base.jpg and base-N.jpg), so new variants join their group automatically. Cards pick an illustration from the group mapped to their tags, so papers with similar tags share a consistent illustration family. Papers with no matching tag fall back to a global hash. Only original artwork ships here; add your own characters via illustration_groups.local.json (gitignored) so they aren't redistributed.
